query: I spent last weekend trying a new matcha bakery in the neighborhood, their red bean mochi is so chewy and not too sweet, I ended up buying a whole box to share with my coworkers. I also just signed up for a beginner pottery class that starts next Wednesday, I’m really excited to try making my own mug even if it ends up a little lopsided. Oh right, I also just finished binging that new sci-fi miniseries everyone’s talking about, the plot twist in the final episode had me staring at my screen for five minutes straight. Anyway, I’m having issues with my phone right now: my wifi calling is really bad, my APN MMS settings seem to be broken, my data mode is turned off, I’ve exceeded my data usage limit, and I think my SIM card might be unseated.
